Jamie (Sales): Heads-up — large healthcare prospect wants an on‑prem, fully air‑gapped POC. Key asks: offline installer, incremental patches (no full reimage), customer HSM/KMS integration, SAML SSO, and a clear upgrade cadence they can audit. Also asked which pricing option applies (one‑time license + annual support vs reserved nodes). Is anything here an immediate blocker?

Priya - Solutions Eng: Thanks Jamie. Can we get their target HW spec and whether their SOC requires signed bundles + attestation? If they need attestation we should offer our signed + hashed bundles + offline activation flow.

Ben, DevEx: Not a blocker, but packaging notes: we currently provide a signed tarball + delta patch mechanism used in other pilots. Offline apply example (for ops):

```
# verify bundle
sha256sum redwood-offline-bundle-2026.03.tar.gz
# apply delta (offline)
redwood-offline-upgrade --apply delta-2026-03.patch --bundle redwood-offline-bundle-2026.03.tar.gz --offline
```

The delta tool writes to /var/lib/redwood/kvcache, keeps DB migrations idempotent. We should confirm the customer will allow the installer to run as root or provide an ops-runbook. :clipboard:

Alex K.: A few constraints to call out:
- KMS: we support KMIP/HSM and envelope encryption; though for some HSMs we need an out-of-band keywrap flow (customer supplies wrapped key).
- Licensing: offline activation currently supports a license token file signed by us; if they require per-node licensing we can support it but pricing changes.
- Upgrades: recommend quarterly feature rollouts + monthly critical/patch updates. If they insist on monthly feature updates that increases testing surface and support SLAs.

Maria S.: Also need their BOM: GPU model, driver/kernel versions, NICs, and storage types. Delta patches assume compatible libc/kernel. If they run very old kernels we may need a full bundle or a compatibility shim.

Jamie (Sales): Good — they're running RHEL 8.6, Nvidia A10s, air-gapped VLANs, and SOC wants signed bundles + proof of patch history. Budget is leaning to one-time license + annual support. They want a pricing ballpark to present this week.

Ben, DevEx: For ballpark: offline on‑prem package (license + support) — start at a three‑node minimum for enterprise POC: $75k one‑time + $18k/yr support, or reserved node pricing if they want throughput guarantees (contact finance for exact numbers). I'll sync with finance tomorrow. :money_with_wings:

Security (GRC): Please kick off the security questionnaire ASAP. We need the following from the customer to complete our answers:
- Data flow diagram for POC (what leaves the network, callback addresses)
- Threat model for offline upgrade process
- KMS/HSM vendor and integration method
- Retention and key rotation requirements
- Required evidence for bundle signing verification (which hashes/certs they accept)

Priya - Solutions Eng: I'll ask the customer for the BOM and the SOC requirement doc. Also will propose our standard POC runbook: 2 weeks sandbox + 1 week smoke tests + optional load run.

InfraBot: build/offline-bundle/1861234501 SUCCESS — redwood-offline-bundle-2026.03 created (sha256: e3b0c44...). Link: https://ci.redwood/examples/offline-bundles/2026.03

Alex K.: If Legal/Security needs the changelog for patches, we can provide a signed changelog artifact for each delta. That should satisfy audit requirements.

Jamie (Sales): Great — action items: (1) Priya to request BOM + SOC doc (2) Ben to confirm pricing with finance (3) Security to start questionnaire draft and list required customer artifacts (4) DevEx to prepare runbook & delta verification snippet for customer ops. Target: have a POC scoping email ready by EOD Fri. :calendar:

Maria S.: Quick note — schedule a 30m ops prep call with their infra lead before handing over the bundle. We've had 2 pilots where kernel mismatch required a fallback plan.

Ben, DevEx: ack. I'll create an ops checklist and attach the upgrade CLI examples + troubleshooting tips.

Security (GRC): ack. Starting questionnaire draft now, will share PR link here when ready.

Jamie (Sales): Thanks all — will follow up after Priya collects the docs. :thumbsup:
